notes.title: Removing Quantum Pilot
notes.content:
Removing Quantum PIlot from stores.
The game as it is does not match the experience I want players to have.

notes.title: Mouse support + Coop improvements + Better Pause Menu
notes.content:
New bullet mechanic in Coop Shuffle
Mouse support for Solo (Just move and click to use)
Delay Pause menu opening top prevent accidental scroll to exit game

notes.title: Bullet Collision Optimizations
notes.content:
Bullet Collision Optimizations
Fixed Highscore typo for new mode

notes.title: New Weapon
notes.content: I redid the MoonCutter weapon. Instead of delaying then zooming forward, it oscillates vertically. Much stronger than the previous 2 iterations.

notes.title: Freeze Bullets By Shooting
notes.content:
Shuffle modes added. Freeze all bullets by shooting.
Buffed MoonCutter weapon.
Decreased initial Deadline rush penalty for getting hit.

notes.title: New patch, minor bug fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed Aftermath unlock not always unlocking from beating the game
* Fixed minor weapon color glitch in Aftermath mode

notes.title: Quick Restart Bug Fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug where quick-restart + show instructions would still pause on a new game. Now it instantly continues.

notes.title: Aftermath Difficulty Modes
notes.content:
* Bugfix: Can now toggle Fullscreen with gamepad
* Solo Aftermatch & Coop Aftermath modes: These are unlocked by fighting your way past the Deadline... with 3 distinct changes to keep the intensity high

notes.title: Gamepad + Pause menu bugfix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug where rapid pause > unpause using Gamepad could freeze the game.

notes.title: Settings Update!
notes.content:
* Keyboard can now shoot with Space, Z or Shift
* Fixed keyboard rapid scroll when controller was plugged in
* Settings menu for disabling instruction prompt
* Faster title load
* Improved UI on Pause Menu

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: the best new indie games on Steam
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly digest of hidden gems embedded into the vast mountain of new Steam releases over the past seven days.

This week: praying mantises gettin’ it on, 80s neon puzzling, obscure Russian Doom clones and the shmup where every enemy is your own past.
